def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # fix category label variants
    cat_map = {'Office Suplies': 'Office Supplies', 'Accesories': 'Accessories'}
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].replace(cat_map)
    # normalize Region whitespace/case variants (missing stays NaN)
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].apply(lambda v: v.strip().title() if isinstance(v, str) else v)
    # normalize dates to YYYY-MM-DD
    d = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'], errors='coerce')
    df['Date'] = d.dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Category'])
    g = df.groupby('Category')['Price'].mean()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
